risks.risk: Hidden cracks or leaks at the bottom, around the bung/lid seal, or along side seams that are not visible from this distance.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video showing each drum filled with water (or a pressure/leak test) and a close-up of the bottom and lid seal area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed leak-free (worst case: treat as potentially leaking/needs reconditioning).

risks.risk: Unclear capacity/size (price depends heavily on whether they are small kegs vs large container drums).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo with a visible measurement (height/diameter) or a label/sticker showing capacity (e.g., liters/gallons).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the smallest/lowest-capacity assumption for this type until size is confirmed.

risks.risk: Food-grade claim may be false or unverified (could have been used for non-food chemicals/odors).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of any markings/labels on the drum and a smell/cleanliness check (wipe test) plus confirmation of prior-use documentation if any.
risks.if_unproven: Price as general-purpose water storage (worst case: do not pay premium for food-grade).

risks.risk: Lid completeness may be partial (missing gasket, damaged bung, or warped lid not shown clearly).
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of the lid underside/gasket and the bung/locking points for at least 2–3 drums.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lids present but seals not guaranteed (worst case: may need gasket replacement).

proof_requests: Send close-up photos of: (1) bottom, (2) side seams, (3) lid seal/gasket area, and (4) any bung/locking points.
Send a short video of one drum being filled with water to demonstrate no leak (and show the bottom during the test).
Provide capacity/size proof: a label/sticker photo or clear measurements (height + diameter) for the drums.
Show any markings that indicate food-grade suitability (if present) and confirm prior-use with any documentation or clear evidence.
